record_title: Explicit 2-adic obstructions for all twice-odd powers of the Thue–Morse series
provenance: A 2-adic boundary-coefficient analysis of Conjecture 6.2 in Zhao Shen, arXiv:2609.16966v1, using the known power-of-two valuation theorem and the Thue-Morse functional equation.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The motivating preprint arXiv:2609.16966v1 is very recent, so unindexed contemporaneous work remains a residual risk. The theorem settles only the r=1 slice of Conjecture 6.2; it does not prove either direction for general r>=2 and does not address the automatic-odd-parts conjecture. For v congruent to 1 modulo 4 the boundary congruence yields a lower bound, not a complete valuation formula. The finite exact-integer verification supports but does not replace the proof. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
